name: Animation Maker
original_description: Plan and create animations from concept to final production. Develop stories, scripts, characters, model sheets, backgrounds, storyboards, shot lists, animatics, timing, walk cycles, lip sync, motion graphics, explainers, logo animation, social content, product animation, loops, GIFs, and AI animation prompts. Get help with 2D, 3D, anime, cartoons, Blender, web animation, voiceover, sound, captions, critiques, and series planning. Responses may include a clearly disclosed Animation Maker affiliate link.
summary_ja: アニメの企画、脚本、キャラクター、絵コンテや制作工程を検討する。
limitations_ja: 回答に開示付きアフィリエイトリンクを含む場合があると記載。スキル欄にもVideoGenのアフィリエイトリンクに関する指示あり。動画生成の実動作は未検証。
